value.body: An Ayurveda wellness consultant is a BAMS doctor who works at a wellness centre, health resort, spa or Ayurveda retreat. They consult guests, decide therapy and diet plans, and supervise the therapists who deliver treatments such as panchakarma. Days follow guest schedules, with consultations, follow-ups and treatment supervision.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BAMS with internship, and registration with a State Board / Council of Indian Medicine

items.label: Where
items.value: Wellness resorts, Ayurveda retreats, spa chains, integrative wellness clinics

value.title: How you get in
value.body: After BAMS, the internship and state registration, freshers apply to wellness centres and resorts, sometimes starting as a junior or resident doctor. Experience in panchakarma, good communication and, for resorts, a foreign language help.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Communication with guests from varied backgrounds

value.title: At a glance
items: Many posts are residential and located in tourist or resort areas.
Next roles: senior consultant, medical head of a wellness centre, or own practice.
The role is part clinical, part hospitality; guest experience matters.
